entries.Original: Automatically summons Eos on login, instance entry, and after a full wipe.
entries.Translated: 登录、进入副本以及团灭后自动召唤 Eos。

entries.Original: Repositions Eos to the arena center in 8-player raids. Triggers automatically when you target the boss.
entries.Translated: 在8人团中将 Eos 移动到场地中心。选中首领时自动触发。

entries.Original: If you manually reposition Eos during a raid, auto-repositioning pauses. A placement target button (⊙) will appear on screen — click it to send Eos back to the arena center and resume auto-placement. Drag it to position it next to your pet action bar.
entries.Translated: 若在副本中手动移动了 Eos，自动放置将暂停。屏幕上会出现放置目标按钮（⊙）——点击可让 Eos 返回场地中心并恢复自动放置。可将其拖动到宠物技能栏附近。

entries.Original: Move the button back to the center of the screen.

entries.Translated: 按钮位置：默认（屏幕中心）。

entries.Original: Play alert sound when Biolysis falls off
entries.Translated: 当蛊毒法效果消失时播放提示音

entries.Original: Enter an 8-player raid to configure its arena center.
entries.Translated: 进入8人团以配置其场地中心。

entries.Original: Remove custom center and revert to default (100, 100).
entries.Translated: 移除自定义中心点并恢复默认值 (100, 100)。

entries.Original: Fill X/Z fields with your current in-game position.
entries.Translated: 将当前游戏内位置填入 X/Z 字段。

entries.Original: Fill X/Z fields with Eos's current position.
entries.Translated: 将 Eos 的当前位置填入 X/Z 字段。
已保存的自定义中心点：
[XIVSchAssistant] ⚠ 无法到达该区域的场地中心点

entries.Original: Eos could not reach the default position (100, 100) — this arena has a non-standard center. Use /xivsch → Custom Arena Centers to configure the correct position.
entries.Translated: Eos 无法到达默认位置 (100, 100)——该场地的中心点并非标准位置。请使用 /xivsch → 自定义场地中心点 配置正确的位置。

entries.Original: [XIVSchAssistant] No target selected — please target the boss first, then click again to return Eos to the arena center.
entries.Translated: [XIVSchAssistant] 未选择目标——请先选定 Boss，然后再次点击使 Eos 返回场地中心。

entries.Original:
Return Eos to arena center
Drag to reposition
entries.Translated:
将 Eos 返回场地中心
拖动可调整位置
